description: Religion spreads through actual families, leisure preaching, Priests and nearby settlements. Sustained social credibility can develop normal committed belief (40–60), but not exceptional high Devotion.

semantics.childUpbringing: Repeated household contact creates own religious affiliation. Two 80+ parents can gradually nurture children up to Devotion 55, but never inherit Zealot/Devout bands outright.
semantics.preaching: Residents and priests autonomously preach during their non-work social phase. Actual recent local preachers allow low-probability uptake; Priest has greater reach/credibility.
semantics.devotion: Sustained social teaching can gradually cross 40 into regular stable follower status, with slower growth above 40 and a capped ordinaryConsolidationCap of 60. Exceptional 80+ devotion still relies chiefly on attributed divine evidence; no passive erosion without rival belief.
semantics.migration: Faith follows actual people and households; exchange is abstract nearby social contact, not teleportation or divine broadcast.
semantics.reproducibility: Seven-day low-rate pulses use a separate seeded religion PRNG, preserving economic PRNG inputs.
